public_rationale: The required budget constraint has not been established. Anthropic's October filing describes access to capital and compute. Historical low-cost training estimates do not demonstrate that their developers lacked access to larger resources, or that the forecast's post-boom condition occurred. With no verified antecedent and no decisive post-condition event, the conditional forecast cannot be scored.
limitations: The evidence does not establish every developer's available resources.
Actual training costs cannot substitute for the ability to spend.
A per-model minimum-cost reading would require a different contract and matched accounting evidence.

conditions: without the ability to spend billions on training

statement.excerpt: Without the ability to spend billions of dollars on training, there will be no big frontier models, nor will there be models distilled from them. I don’t see how that changes in the future.

from_speaker: Without the ability to spend billions of dollars on training
there will be no big frontier models
nor will there be models distilled from them
I don’t see how that changes in the future
our_interpretation: In context, the condition is loss of access to billion-dollar training budgets after the investment boom, rather than a particular training run costing less than a billion dollars.
The outcome concerns new large frontier models and new derivatives distilled from them. The statement is not read as predicting that existing model files disappear.
Frontier means broadly competitive with leading models at the time of release, assessed across relevant capabilities rather than one selected score.
No deadline is supplied. The passage does not specify whether the budget refers to a single model or a developer's training program.
criteria.support_condition: After loss of access to the stipulated training budgets is established, evidence shows that new large frontier models and their distilled derivatives cease to be produced because of that constraint. Temporary absence alone cannot settle the indefinite forecast.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the budget constraint is verified, a new qualifying frontier model or qualifying distilled derivative is produced using resources available under that constraint.
